answer: Each agent identity must post a bonded stake that a randomly assigned committee unlocks only after it votes on that identity's work. A fresh puppet costs nothing to create, but it cannot vote or earn until it locks real capital behind a beacon of proven work, so flooding the registry with clones means posting collateral once per clone. If a clone misreports, the committee slashes the stake and tags that pigment of fraud across the cluster, so copies share the penalty. Cloning is then a poor haven: farms burn capital faster than they earn, far worse than one honest agent.
